import numpy as np
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor

X = np.array([np.nan, np.nan, 3, 4, 5, 6]).reshape(-1, 1)
y = np.arange(6)
tree = DecisionTreeRegressor(random_state=0).fit(X, y)
imp = np.asarray(tree.tree_.impurity, dtype=float)
leaves_idx = np.flatnonzero((tree.tree_.children_left == -1) & (tree.tree_.n_node_samples == 1))
if leaves_idx.size:
    max_abs_leaf = float(np.max(np.abs(imp[leaves_idx])))
else:
    max_abs_leaf = float("nan")
probe("max_abs_single_sample_leaf_impurity", max_abs_leaf)
probe("min_impurity_all_nodes", float(np.min(imp)))
probe("all_impurities_nonnegative", float(1.0 if np.all(imp >= 0) else 0.0))
